notes.title: New game topics is on the way -- will be delivered as the game update
notes.content:
Hello all!

We want to share with you some info about our future plans for this game.
The game database was initially designed to be easily expanded, and after release we immediately started to create questions for the next two topics.

The topics that are in progress right now are:

 Geography, where you can find the questions about the countries' flags, capitals, well known rivers, lakes, and mountains, deserts and so on.
 Birds, where you hopefully can learn something new :) There will be a lot of questions with images in this category, where, for example, you should name the depicted bird.


Of course, it is not the complete list of the planned topics, I listed only those that are in the development right now. Stay tuned!

By the way, which topic do YOU want to be added to this game? Share your thoughts in the comments, and maybe we'll add these topics too!

Wish you all the best,
NLB project team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 + Linux support
notes.content:
Hello all!

We have updated the game to version 1.0.1. The changes are:

     Added fullscreen option in the settings menu, so that you can now toggle fullscreen mode on and off.
     Added auto updating of the available games list on 'Join game' screen. The game checks for available games every 20 seconds, when the game is found, it plays a sound signal.
     Added flag icon to the language selection box in the start menu and increased its font size. We hope that it should increase its visibility :)


Also, we have added the Linux versions. I tried to do my best to find out why Linux versions don't work well with Steam integration in some cases, but please note, that there can still be bugs.

Overall, singleplayer game should work fine on Linux, but you can experience problems with multiplayer and other Steam features (achievements, leaderboards). If you'll experience such problems, please, don't hesitate to create a forum post describing your problem, and I'll try to help you.

Have a nice day,
Best regards,
NLB project team
